candidates.claim: A stalled newer Default range read makes firstLoad discard an older valid answer; the panel opens on 7d while the setting says otherwise until the next change or restart.
candidates.trigger: 1. Panel mounts; firstLoad starts read A (readDefaultRange, read=1, get pending). 2. User changes Default range; onDidChange fires; read B starts (defaultRangeReads=2). 3. Host answers A with '30d' first: second .then checks read === defaultRangeReads (1 vs 2), so state.defaultRange is not set; third .then returns early. 4. B's settings.get stalls; host shell rejects it with code timeout after ~120 s (plugin-panel-shell.js:115, per prior settled fact). 5. B's rejection handler runs, third .then resolves waiters. 6. firstLoad resumes: state.defaultRange is still '7d'; rangePicked false, moved false; the 1.5 s fallback already loaded 7d, so no reload. Panel opens on 7d, clearFilter('range') also returns to 7d.
candidates.wrong: Should: keep the last valid answer (A's '30d') when the newest read yields nothing usable. Does: the older valid answer is discarded, leaving the setting-less 7d default for the session.
candidates.path: src/panel/panel.js:624 -> src/panel/panel.js:601 -> src/panel/panel.js:603-611 -> src/panel/panel.js:162 (readDefaultRange, firstLoad, clearFilter)
candidates.confidence: medium; needs the host to stall settings.get for the newer read. Not reproduced; a test with a never-answering second get and an answered first get would settle it.
candidates.class: newer-generation guard drops an older valid result when the newer one yields nothing
candidates.sweep: Sibling: the same guard drops an older valid answer when the newer answer is invalid or unreadable (pack suspicion, checked-broken by same path, low). Other async reads: onDidChange handler at panel.js:596 is the only other reader of settings; loadPrices/priceAction use their own request, not this guard (not checked in depth).
